name: OpenObserve

evidence.logs: C02: unified logs with SQL and full-text search (L02)
evidence.errors: E01: browser uncaught errors and rejections grouped by type and message
evidence.uptime: U01, U02: HTTP, TCP, TLS and SSH checks every 5 minutes by default
evidence.status: S01, S03: check-driven public status pages with 90-day uptime history
evidence.performance: A01: OpenTelemetry traces with span search, waterfall and flame views

line: Collects logs, traces and browser errors, with synthetic checks and status pages.

free.text: Free OSS self-host; Cloud trial 14 days
